jobs.description:
Do you like to keep moving and see your work get done by the end of the morning? For our client in Aalsmeer, we are looking for order pickers and logistics employees. The work starts early and keeps you on your feet. This is what you bring:
- You are available at least 3 days per week
- You are always available on Monday and Friday
- You can start at 06:00 in Aalsmeer
- You are physically fit and enjoy active work
- You work accurately and take responsibility for your orders
- You speak Dutch or English

jobs.description:
As a logistics employee at Samsung SDS in Breda, you will help get products from Samsung and other companies to the right place. You work in a team where there are regular staff meetings to get to know each other better.

Your tasks depend on the position. Primarily your tasks will be physical, so you need to be physicaly fit. You might be packing and preparing products like microwaves and tv's for shipment. Or you might be loading and unloading containers either with forklift or manually.

You will work two shifts: early (6 a.m. to 3.00 p.m.) or late (3.00 p.m. to 0.00 p.m.).

You will work between 30 and 40 hours per week. 

Do you want to contribute to Samsung's success? Then apply now!

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. When you work in shifts, public transport is not possible
- You speak good English, which is helpful in this international environment.
- You are available full-time
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation.

It is nice if you are flexible. Sometimes we work overtime or on weekends. But don't worry, that doesn't happen every week!

Have you already gained some logistical experience and are you looking for a job that is easy to combine with your free time? Look no further, because at UPS, you are in the right place! You can also count on a gross salary of €15.85 per hour, travel allowance, pension accrual, and a chance for a permanent contract! Are you excited? Read on and apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for multiple part-time order pickers for UPS in Amsterdam.

In this role, you will process incoming goods and packages. You will scan and check the packages and accompanying documents, sort the shipments, and load the trucks according to the route. You can imagine that accuracy is key. Furthermore, you will also do a lot of walking, lifting, and carrying, so it is important that you are physically fit.

There are different departments where you can work. During the application process, we will look at which department suits you best!

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.85 per hour including 1.38% ADV allowance
    
- Travel allowance according to UPS's scheme
    
- Part-time job that is easy to combine with other activities
    
- Free access to the e-learning platform Manpower Academy
    
- Pension plan via Manpower
    
- Temporary job with the chance of extension
    
- Friendly team with a great atmosphere
    
- Bonus of €250 per quarter

    - At least six months of work experience as an order picker, warehouse employee, logistics employee, or similar
    
- At least 18 years of age, because of the working activities and hours
    
- Good command of the Dutch or English language, due to safety regulations in the workplace
    
- Physically capable of performing heavier work such as lifting and carrying
    
- A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) plus a Security Clearance (VGB)
    
- Availability of at least 20 hours per week
    
- Flexibility regarding the working hours
